headline: No API changes break the bot today, so the ideas give you a pre-written plan for after a loss, show how much fees take at high leverage, and flag thin coins before you enter.

ideas.title: If-then plan that the bot shows you after a loss
ideas.why: Write 2–3 rules ahead of time, like "If I lose a trade, then I close Binance for 15 minutes." Plans set in if-then form have a medium-to-large effect on sticking to goals and on holding back emotional reactions. The bot repeats your rule after each loss.

ideas.title: Fee drag line in /report and /tilt
ideas.why: Binance charges 0.05% taker fee on the full position size, so a 40× round trip costs about 4% of your margin before price moves (2% at 20×). Show fees paid per day against gross PnL, so overtrading days show what the extra trades cost you.

ideas.title: "Thin" flag for movers with a wide spread
ideas.why: Top movers are often thin coins where the spread and slippage eat a scalp. One bookTicker call covers every symbol: flag a coin when its spread is many times BTC's. At 0.25% slippage each way, a trade must move 0.5% just to break even.
